description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.5.4
🚀 New
- Hidden Debug tab in Settings
🐛 Fixes
- debug symbols appearing as Godot editors; PR by shiena
✨ Improvements
- The command line can now open a project by its folder path, not just its name: godothub open <path>. If the folder is already in GodotHub it opens with its usual version and launch arguments; if it isn't, you can pick a Godot version and optionally add it to GodotHub (#219)
- godothub open takes --godot , --add and --no-add so it can open a folder without prompting, which makes it easy to wire into a git client or other tool
- Chinese Locale Updated; PR by hanmi255
- Japanese Locale Updated; PR by shiena
